evidenceBoundary.exact: The selected installed CHK SHA256, shader CAB/PathID/source offset, targeted conversion manifest, sidecar manifest and selected SPIR-V and metadata SHA256 are checked. The named serialized texture parameter is joined to a SPIR-V descriptor-set/binding variable; four direct image samples and component-zero extracts are checked on that variable's SSA path.
evidenceBoundary.direct: The authored HGRP/HGTerrainPS VTBakePage Vulkan fragment program declares _ConeMaps as a 2D array texture at set 3/binding 11 and samples component zero from it four times.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: The separate selected UnityPlayer LAYER_C path-result consumer binds its owner-local resource under the _ConeMaps property ID when the source and destination checks pass. This shader witness shows a matching authored input and sample path, not that a particular installed LAYER_C file reached this shader in a live session.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: The LAYER_C stored byte's visual meaning, a link into any managed VirtualTextureRenderer field, runtime shader and file selection, and output effect of the sampled value remain unproved.
